∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : AddCommGroup.{u_1} M] [inst_1 : Module.{0, u_1} Complex M]
  [FiniteDimensional.{0, u_1} Complex M]
  [inst_3 : LieRingModule.{0, u_1} (Subtype.{1} fun x => Membership.mem.{0, 0} Etingof.sl2 x) M]
  [LieModule.{0, 0, u_1} Complex (Subtype.{1} fun x => Membership.mem.{0, 0} Etingof.sl2 x) M]
  (N : LieSubmodule.{0, 0, u_1} Complex (Subtype.{1} fun x => Membership.mem.{0, 0} Etingof.sl2 x) M),
  Exists.{u_1 + 1} fun N' => IsCompl.{u_1} N N'

∀ (V : Type u) [inst : AddCommGroup.{u} V] [inst_1 : Module.{0, u} Complex V] [FiniteDimensional.{0, u} Complex V]
  [inst_3 : LieRingModule.{0, u} (Subtype.{1} fun x => Membership.mem.{0, 0} Etingof.sl2 x) V]
  [LieModule.{0, 0, u} Complex (Subtype.{1} fun x => Membership.mem.{0, 0} Etingof.sl2 x) V],
  Exists.{1} fun m =>
    Exists.{1} fun n =>
      Nonempty.{max 1 (u + 1)}
        (LieModuleEquiv.{0, 0, u, 0} Complex (Subtype.{1} fun x => Membership.mem.{0, 0} Etingof.sl2 x) V
          ((i : Fin m) → Fin (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (n i) 1) → Complex))
